facts.text: Tim is currently learning German, which he finds tough but worth it.

evidence.quote: Learning German has been tough but worth it.
I'm learning German now - tough but fun.

facts.text: John has started learning Spanish and finds it useful for personal and professional opportunities.

evidence.quote: I've always wanted to learn Spanish. I just stared with it. It's such a useful language with many personal and professional opportunities!

facts.text: Tim and John both use the same app to practice learning languages.

evidence.quote: I've been using that app on my phone to practice too!

facts.text: Tim mentions that learning another language opens up opportunities and is rewarding despite the difficulty.

evidence.quote: Knowing another language opens up a lot of opportunities.
Learning another language is tough, but the rewards are totally worth it.
